prompt:
Make one opaque pixel-art eye atlas for common portrait NPC082 ANGRY, using this single image as the exact source/reference. Canvas: exact 2 columns × 2 rows, equal cells, overall aspect ratio 64:35 (about 1.83:1), each cell represents one native 64×35 eye-area crop. No gutters, margins, labels, borders, text, extra panels, or background beyond the source crop. Row-major cell order: top-left LEFT/open; top-right RIGHT/open; bottom-left LEFT/half; bottom-right RIGHT/half. Both eyes must glance together in each cell.

This is a restrained horizontal-gaze variant of this exact angry face. Preserve the angry expression, source brow shapes and position, eye spacing, face identity, source pixel scale, eyelid contours, and original color palette. Keep the upper and lower eyelid contour and eye aperture exactly as shown for each phase. Do not widen, enlarge, lift, or reshape the eye opening. Keep the open-row aperture like the source open eyes; keep the half-row aperture and lid coverage like the source half eyes. Change only the compact iris/pupil placement by a gentle shift of about one native pixel toward the viewer's left in the LEFT cells or toward the viewer's right in the RIGHT cells. Keep both pupils fully inside the original apertures, naturally partly bounded by the existing lids, with the same compact irregular stepped shape and size as source.

Retain source eye colors: muted brown-beige sclera, small dark pupils and source-colored muted irises. Keep any visible sclera limited to the source's few native pixels; no bright white bands or broad pale patches. Tiny restrained glints only, muted and no brighter than source highlights. Do not increase iris width, whiteness, shine, contrast, or eye size. Do not alter brows, eyelid contours, forehead, hair, skin, face, background, framing, or pixels outside the eye features. Crisp native pixel edges; no smoothing, blur, antialiasing, resampling, invented colors, or painterly detail. Only the four requested cells; no closed or vertical gaze.
